entries.name: Dumbbell Shrug
entries.reason: Draft repair: stationary head, trunk, pelvis and leg anchors; the separate shoulder girdle translates the extended arms and load. Peak hold is1000ms. Independent source/render review required.
entries.summary: Raise and lower the shoulders with long arms and a quiet body.

frames.caption: Stand tall with the dumbbells hanging as dead weight.
With intention, pull the shoulder blades up behind your ears.
Rise as high as the traps will take them.
Own a full second at the top.
Lower until you feel the traps stretch.
Let the weight stretch the traps at the bottom.

entries.name: Barbell Shrug
entries.reason: Draft repair: stationary head, trunk, pelvis and leg anchors; the separate shoulder girdle translates the extended arms and load. Peak hold is1000ms. Independent source/render review required.
entries.summary: Raise and lower the shoulders with long arms and a quiet body.

frames.caption: Hold the barbell in front of your thighs with straight arms.
With intention, pull the shoulder blades up behind the ears.
Rise as high as the traps will take them.
Own the top for a full second.
Lower until the weight stretches the traps.
Keep the arms like ropes as the shoulders settle.

entries.name: Barbell Shrug Behind The Back
entries.reason: Redrawn on 9 October 2026 at the owner's request, from the description he accepted that day: the earlier drawing held the bar in front of the body. Source-bound side-view draft: standing tall with the bar hanging at arm's length behind the body; the arms stay straight and only the shoulders lift, straight up, hold for a second, and lower more slowly. The bar is seen end-on. Not drawn: the palms-back grip and the hand width, which a side view cannot show.
entries.summary: Standing tall with a barbell at arm's length behind you, lift the shoulders straight up with the arms straight, hold for a second, then lower slowly.

frames.caption: Stand tall with the feet shoulder-width apart and a barbell hanging at arm's length behind you, palms facing back and the hands a little wider than the shoulders.
Keeping the arms straight and the bar close to your body, lift the shoulders straight up as high as they go.
Hold for a second. Arms stay long.
Lower slowly to the start.
Do not bend the elbows or roll the shoulders to help.

entries.name: Cable Shrugs
entries.reason: Redrawn on 9 October 2026 at the owner's request, from the description he accepted that day: the earlier drawing did not show where the cable or the bar was. Source-bound side-view draft: standing tall close to a low pulley with the bar hanging in front on straight arms; only the shoulders lift, hold for a second, and lower. The cable runs from the low pulley to the bar and only lengthens as the shoulders rise. Not drawn: the overhand grip.
entries.summary: Standing tall close to a low pulley with the bar hanging in front, lift the shoulders as high as they go with the arms straight, hold for a second, then lower under control.

frames.caption: Stand facing a low pulley, close to it, and take the bar with an overhand grip, palms facing your thighs, then stand tall with the arms hanging straight down in front of you.
Keeping the arms straight, lift the shoulders as high as they go.
Hold a second at the top.
Lower the bar back to the start under control.
Arms stay long. Only the shoulders move.
